decisions.decision: For the current FrameWebforCS desktop print feature, call the existing FramePrintPDF/PDF_Manager in process through a bounded byte-returning entry point, project canonical desktop input/results to its legacy root only at this boundary, and show an owner-bound modal with WebView2 preview, exact-byte PDF save, and the system printer dialog. This supersedes the earlier typed PDFsharp cutover decision for this feature; FramePrintAzure compatibility is not required.
decisions.rationale: The approved feature must reproduce the reachable FrameWebforJS reports and diagrams now while keeping all print controls inside FrameWebforCS. Reusing the existing PDF composer preserves report layout and supports a direct C# call without the former HTTP POST. A single generated byte array keeps preview and save consistent.
decisions.alternatives: Continue the prior typed PDFsharp replacement before print parity; keep the JavaScript POST/HTTP print host; maintain FramePrintAzure compatibility.
